title: Support for Journalists
content: Calling all journalists from the Global South! The period to submit open applications for travel support to attend the IGF 2026 in Nairobi, Kenya is now OPEN until 26 October. See the terms & eligibility criteria and apply.

title: IGF 2027 MAG Renewal
content: All stakeholders are invited to submit nominations for the MAG 2027. Successful nominees will serve a one-year term and contribute to the IGF’s multistakeholder work. Deadline for nominations: 5 November.
